transformations.content:
\myCmts{Reviewed partial result: the upper bound at scale $t^\kappa$
is proved for $0<\alpha\le1$ in dimensions one, two and three under
the standing assumptions. The separate one-dimensional Riesz
estimates retain their sharper constants and white endpoint.
Degree-one covariance in dimensions two and three does not mean
full spatial white noise. Section~\ref{S:interval-upper} treats the
higher exponents by a separate argument; the sharp constant remains open.}

\myCmts{Candidate argument, pending independent review. This section concerns
isotropic Riesz covariance in dimensions two and three. It does not promote
the preceding candidate, settle general anisotropic covariance, or identify
the sharp constant. The accepted scope stated elsewhere is unchanged.}

\myCmts{Candidate argument, pending independent review. This section gives
complete endpoint constructions and a complete planar transfer. It does not
use the preceding candidate proposition as an accepted input. Earlier
accepted-scope statements and review confidence remain unchanged.}

\myCmts{Expanded candidate, pending independent review of the new assembly.
The conditional moment transfer has not passed the required high-confidence
gate. The plane-supported endpoints and finite-sum comparison were reviewed
separately as deterministic tools. We now include their proofs, a new
linear-image closure argument, and the resulting moment applications.
Earlier accepted-scope statements are unchanged; no general
three-dimensional factorization is asserted.}

\myCmts{The energy-identification lemma passed a scoped independent review.
The full conditional moment argument has not passed its required gate.
This source-functional identification does not promote the separate
conditional moment argument or resolve general covariance factorization.}

\myCmts{The static contraction and first-variance phase estimates
passed a scoped independent review.
The full general-covariance moment goal and the preceding candidate
moment arguments retain their stated status.}

\myCmts{The regularized static phase and interaction estimates
passed a scoped independent review.
This does not yet give a bound for overlapping time blocks or the
time-fractional model.}

\myCmts{The complete full-target upper-bound argument passed a scoped
independent review, including the interval coefficients and source transfer.
The sharp constant, formal verification and final whole-paper cold read
remain open.}

\myCmts{Theorem~\ref{T:full-upper} establishes the unchanged full upper
goal for every admissible dimension and homogeneous covariance.
Its complete proof has passed independent correctness review.
The earlier explicit bounds for $0<\alpha\le1$ remain available.
The sharp constant and final whole-paper cold read remain open.}
